title: atuna latifolia
intro: Atuna latifolia, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra. The Borneo ironwood is valued for its timber and has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of A. latifolia include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
